name: Numbering
what_it_does: Starts or toggles a numbered list on the selected paragraphs; the dropdown is the numbering library.
behavior: Opens subfeature:numbering-gallery (dropdown). Contents (13 controls): Numbering, None, 1, 2, 3, …, ALIGNMENT Left, Number Format: 1., 1, 2, 3, …, ALIGNMENT Left, Number Format: 1), I, II, III, …, ALIGNMENT Right, Number Format: I., A, B, C, …, ALIGNMENT Left, Number Format: A., a, b, c, …, ALIGNMENT Left, Number Format: a), a, b, c, …, ALIGNMENT Left, Number Format: a., i, ii, iii, …, ALIGNMENT Right, Number Format: i., Change List Level, Define New Number Format..., Set Numbering Value..., Color swatches. Sub-surfaces: ui:numbering-dropdown-define-new-number-format, ui:numbering-dropdown-set-numbering-value. [the subfeature:numbering-gallery flyout — items are endpoints; swatches pixel-sampled; sections: Numbering Library] Appears as a numbered list (1,2,3 beside lines) with a dropdown chevron.
